name: Defyn Social Feed
author: Defyn

sections.description:
Defyn Social Feed adds a fast, good-looking Instagram feed to any WordPress site. Connect your Instagram Business or Creator account in one click, pick a layout, and add the feed to a page, post, sidebar or footer with a block, shortcode, widget or Elementor.

There is no subscription, no licence key and no “pro” upsell. Every feature below is included.

Why site owners choose Defyn Social Feed

  • One-click connect. Click “Connect with Instagram”, log in and you’re done. No Meta developer account is needed.
  • Looks right on every screen. Separate column and post counts for desktop, tablet and mobile, so your Instagram gallery never looks cramped on a phone.
  • Fast pages. Feeds refresh in the background and images are saved to your own Media Library in sensible sizes, so visitors never wait on Instagram.
  • Never goes blank. If Instagram is slow or a token expires, the last good posts keep showing and you get an email so you can reconnect.
  • Privacy friendly. Privacy (GDPR) mode serves everything from your own site, so visitors’ browsers never contact Instagram.

Instagram feed layouts

  • Grid – a classic square Instagram grid, 1 to 10 columns.
  • Carousel / slider – one or more rows with arrows, dots, autoplay and looping.
  • Masonry – a Pinterest-style gallery that keeps each photo’s original shape.
  • Highlight – make every few posts, or posts with a hashtag, bigger than the rest.
  • Six ready-made templates, including showcase cards with captions, likes and comments.

Feed types

  • Posts from one or more Instagram Business or Creator accounts
  • Hashtag feeds (top or recent posts, saved over time)
  • Tagged feeds (posts your account is tagged in)
  • Mixed feeds that combine accounts, hashtags and tagged posts

Design options

  • Profile header with avatar, bio, follower and post counts, in standard, centred, boxed or text styles
  • Story ring on the avatar for Facebook-connected accounts
  • Hover overlay with caption, date, likes and comments
  • Aspect ratio (square, portrait, landscape or original), spacing, rounded corners and shadows
  • Light, dark, “match my theme” or custom colours
  • Load more button, infinite scroll and a Follow button

Lightbox, moderation and shoppable posts

  • A built-in lightbox for photos, videos, Reels and albums, with captions, likes and comments, plus keyboard and swipe navigation
  • Moderation: hide posts you don’t want, or show only the ones you pick
  • Shoppable Instagram feed: link any post to a product or page
  • Filter by words or media type, sort by newest, most liked or random, and skip posts with an offset

Works with your site

  • Block editor: add the “Defyn Social Feed” block.
  • Shortcode: [defyn-social-feed feed="1"]
  • Elementor widget, classic widget and the template tag defyn_social_feed( 1 );
  • Live preview editor with desktop, tablet and mobile views
  • Theme-friendly templates you can override in your theme
  • Can restore Instagram post embeds (oEmbed) that WordPress no longer supports on its own

Switching from another Instagram plugin

Moving from another Instagram feed plugin? Defyn Social Feed can take over old [instagram-feed] shortcodes, so a feed in your footer or sidebar keeps working without editing your theme. See the FAQ.

Built in Sydney by Defyn

Defyn Social Feed is made and maintained by Defyn, a WordPress development agency in Sydney. We build and look after WordPress, WooCommerce and Shopify sites, and we use this plugin on our own client sites every day. If you need a hand with your website, get in touch.

External services

This plugin connects to Meta’s APIs to display Instagram content. Nothing is sent until a site administrator connects an account.

  • Defyn connect service (connect.defyn.com.au, operated by Defyn Pty Ltd) – only used when an administrator clicks “Connect with Instagram” without their own Meta app. It relays the Instagram login using Defyn’s Meta app and hands the access token straight back to your site in the browser. Sent: your site’s admin URL and a one-time random value; Instagram then returns a login code to the service, which exchanges it for a token. The service stores nothing. It is never contacted again after connecting (your site renews its token directly with Instagram). Turn it off with define( 'DSFEED_DISABLE_CONNECT_SERVICE', true );. Defyn privacy policy: https://defyn.com.au/privacy-policy-2/

  • Instagram Graph API / Instagram Login (graph.instagram.com, api.instagram.com, www.instagram.com) – used to connect an account (OAuth) and to fetch profile details, posts, comments and access-token renewals for connected Business/Creator accounts. Sent: your app ID and secret during connection, the account’s access token, and the IDs of posts being requested.

  • Facebook Graph API / Facebook Login (graph.facebook.com, www.facebook.com) – used when you connect with Facebook Login, for hashtag search, hashtag/tagged media, stories, comments and (optionally) Instagram oEmbeds. Sent: your app ID and secret during connection, the Page access token, hashtags you configure, and post IDs.
  • Instagram CDN (*.cdninstagram.com, *.fbcdn.net) – post images and videos are downloaded by your server to make local copies. Unless Privacy mode is on, visitors’ browsers may also load images, videos and avatars from these hosts.

Requests are made from your server on a schedule (default hourly) and when a feed is viewed after its cache expires. Visitors’ browsers only contact Meta when Privacy mode is off.

Meta Platform Terms: https://developers.facebook.com/terms/
Meta Privacy Policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/
Instagram Terms of Use: https://help.instagram.com/581066165581870
sections.installation:
1. In your dashboard go to Plugins › Add New, search for “Defyn Social Feed”, then click Install Now and Activate.
  2. Go to Instagram Feeds › Accounts and click Connect with Instagram. Log in to Instagram and confirm.
  3. Go to Instagram Feeds › Add new, choose a template and adjust the layout while watching the live preview. Click Save feed.
  4. Add the feed to your site with the “Defyn Social Feed” block, or paste its shortcode into any page, post or widget.

Using your own Meta app (optional)

You only need your own Meta app for hashtag feeds, tagged feeds and stories, or if you’d rather not use the one-click connect service. Add the app’s IDs under Instagram Feeds › Settings. The Setup guide screen walks you through it step by step.

Agencies can share one app across many sites by adding it to wp-config.php:

define( 'DSFEED_IG_APP_ID', '...' );
define( 'DSFEED_IG_APP_SECRET', '...' );
define( 'DSFEED_FB_APP_ID', '...' );
define( 'DSFEED_FB_APP_SECRET', '...' );
sections.faq:
Is Defyn Social Feed really free?

Yes. Every feature is included. There is no paid version, licence key or subscription.

What kind of Instagram account do I need?

An Instagram Business or Creator account. Meta shut down the API for personal accounts in December 2024. Switching to a Creator account is free and takes a minute in the Instagram app (Settings › Account type and tools).

Do I need to create a Meta / Facebook developer app?

No. Click “Connect with Instagram” and log in. You only need your own app for hashtag feeds, tagged feeds and stories. The Setup guide inside the plugin explains how.

How often does the feed update?

Every hour by default, in the background. You can change this in Settings or clear the feed caches by hand at any time from Settings.

Will my feed stop working when the Instagram token expires?

No. Tokens are renewed automatically before they expire. If Instagram ever refuses a renewal, the last posts keep showing and the site admin gets an email asking them to reconnect.

Can I show more than one Instagram account?

Yes. Connect as many accounts as you like, then show each in its own feed or combine several in one feed.

Can I show a hashtag feed?

Yes, with a Business account connected through your own Meta app with Facebook Login. Meta allows 30 different hashtags per account in any 7-day period.

Is the Instagram feed responsive?

Yes. Every feed has its own column and post settings for desktop, tablet and mobile, and the layout adapts to the space it’s placed in, so it works in narrow sidebars and footers too.

Is it GDPR friendly?

Turn on Privacy mode and visitors’ browsers never load anything from Instagram or Meta. Images and avatars are served from your own site.

Will it slow my site down?

No. Posts are fetched in the background, images are stored locally in web-friendly sizes and load lazily, and the scripts are small, plain JavaScript with no jQuery.

I’m moving from another Instagram plugin. Will my old shortcodes work?

Add add_filter( 'dsfeed_compat_shortcode', '__return_true' ); to your theme or a small plugin. Old [instagram-feed] shortcodes will then show your first Defyn feed, as long as the other plugin is deactivated.

Can I change the HTML or styling?

Yes. Copy any file from the plugin’s /templates folder to your-theme/defyn-social-feed/ and edit it. Templates receive $dsfeed_renderer and $dsfeed_args. For CSS, use Appearance › Customize › Additional CSS or your theme’s Styles.

Developer hooks

Filters: dsfeed_settings_schema, dsfeed_filtered_posts, dsfeed_feed_html, dsfeed_template, dsfeed_graph_version, dsfeed_redirect_uri, dsfeed_instagram_scopes, dsfeed_facebook_scopes, dsfeed_compat_shortcode.
Actions: dsfeed_source_refreshed, dsfeed_cache_flushed.

Where can I get help?

Post in the support forum and we’ll help. For custom work on your website, contact Defyn.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

  • Fixed the Defyn privacy policy link in the External services section.
  • Added Setup guide, Support and Defyn links on the Plugins screen and a “Need a hand?” section in the Setup guide.
  • Clearer plugin description and readme.

1.1.1

  • Removed the Custom CSS setting (use Appearance > Customize > Additional CSS, or the Site Editor’s Styles). Any saved value is cleaned up on update.
  • The “feed stopped updating” notice now only shows on the Plugins screen and the plugin’s own screens, and can be dismissed.

1.1.0

  • One-click “Connect with Instagram” through the Defyn connect service – no Meta app needed.

1.0.0

  • First release.
